tax.text: He argued against raising taxes and supported cutting discretionary spending instead.
tax.quote: We don’t need to raise taxes on Americans and companies when there are so many areas on the discretionary side that we can cut

debt.text: He supported a debt ceiling bill that paired an increase with large federal spending cuts.
debt.quote: This is one of the largest cuts Congress has ever passed because we know we are running out of time to reverse unsustainable deficit spending

safety.text: He voted for bills and resolutions supporting state and local police officers.
safety.quote: In honor of National Police Week, Congressman Josh Brecheen and House Republicans passed several bills and resolutions to support state and local police officers.

immigration.text: He supported the Secure the Border Act, which included border wall construction and limits on catch and release.
immigration.quote: I call on President Biden and Democrats to join Republicans in supporting this common-sense legislation so we can solve our border crisis.

guns.text: He said he strongly supports the Second Amendment and voted to nullify the ATF pistol-brace rule.
guns.quote: I strongly support our second amendment right to bear arms.

abortion.text: He states that he is fully anti-abortion and believes life begins at conception.
abortion.quote: As your Representative, I remain 100% pro-Life and firmly believe that life begins at conception.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for a resolution reversing a Title IX rule that allowed transgender athletes to compete on women’s teams.
gender.quote: The Biden Administration has moved so far to the left that they now want biological men competing in women’s sports.

energy.text: He voted for legislation to increase domestic energy production and lower costs for families.
energy.quote: Today, I was proud to vote in favor of H.R.1 which would increase our domestic energy production, reverse President Biden’s woke climate policies, and lower costs for American families.

voting.text: He voted for the SAVE Act, requiring proof of citizenship when registering to vote and removal of noncitizens from federal voter rolls.
voting.quote: Congressman Josh Brecheen voted in favor of the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which requires states to obtain proof of citizenship in person when registering an individual to vote

tax.text: He proposes raising the corporate tax rate and requiring wealthy people and large corporations to pay more.
tax.quote: Reform the tax system so the wealthy and large corporations pay their fair share.

wages.text: He supports immediately raising the minimum wage to $16 and increasing it annually.
wages.quote: I will work to move the minimum wage to $16.00 immediately and then add legislation to continue to increase it yearly.

trade.text: He said current tariffs raise costs and proposed replacing them with other policies to support U.S. workers.
trade.quote: Current tariff policies are increasing costs for everyday Americans. Instead, hold corporations accountable for moving jobs abroad while supporting those that invest in American workers and communities.

debt.text: He said Social Security and Medicare should be protected and expanded, and proposed eliminating the Social Security tax cap.
debt.quote: Social Security and Medicare are earned benefits that working Americans have paid into their entire lives. These programs must be protected, strengthened, and expanded—not cut.

schools.text: He supports directing education funding to public schools and opposes diverting it to private schools.
schools.quote: Ensure federal and state funds are directed to public schools, not diverted to private institutions.

safety.text: He said police should receive the resources they need and that community programs can also receive funding.
safety.quote: I believe we must provide for everything our police departments need to properly do their jobs. I also believe we can fund both areas without taking from the other.

immigration.text: He proposed faster citizenship processing, lawful employment while cases are pending, and due process protections.
immigration.quote: Streamline the naturalization process so that applicants are not forced to wait multiple years.

guns.text: He called for common-sense gun laws and accountability for people who do not follow them.
guns.quote: I believe we must get back to common sense gun laws. Having accountability for not following these laws. Not just anyone should have a firearm.

abortion.text: He supports codifying Roe v. Wade and protecting patients’ ability to make reproductive healthcare decisions.
abortion.quote: I believe Roe v. Wade should be codified into federal law to guarantee the right to privacy in healthcare decisions.

gender.text: He said transgender people who have transitioned should participate in the area matching their gender, while noting possible sports advantages should be considered.
gender.quote: If the changes has taken place and the hormone therapy is being done, then they should participate in the area they are transitioned to. I do believe we must look into certain sports and the actual advantages that they may have.

health.text: He supports guaranteed coverage for all citizens, including exploring Medicare for All and hybrid models.
health.quote: Build a system where coverage is guaranteed for all citizens, regardless of work status.

energy.text: He called climate change an urgent threat and supports cleaner energy options alongside cleaner production of current energy supplies.
energy.quote: We must work together to ensure we have a planet for generations to come. We must work to provide cleaner options while working with our energy producers to provide a cleaner way of producing the current energy supply.

voting.text: He strongly agreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: If they have their voter ID then yes that should be good enough. We have done it that way for many years.

guns.text: His campaign platform says he supports veterans and the right to bear arms.
guns.quote: I support veterans and the right to bear arms.
